episodeTitle.en: Redefining success, money, and belonging | Paul Millerd (The Pathless Path)
episodeTitle.zh: 重新定义成功、金钱和归属感 | 保罗·米勒德（《无路之路》）

guestBioOfficial.en: Paul Millerd spent several years working in strategy consulting and on the “default path” before deciding to walk away to work on his own in 2017. His book, The Pathless Path, chronicles his own journey and deep dive into the history of work and has been read by more than 40,000 people. His podcast, The Pathless Path Podcast, highlights conversations with others following unconventional paths. He also runs the online training business StrategyU, helping people learn the skills of consulting without having to work in the industry. In our conversation, Paul shares: • An explanation of the “default path” and the “pathless path”
guestBioOfficial.zh: 保罗·米勒德曾在战略咨询领域工作数年，并遵循“默认路径”，直到2017年决定离开，开始自主创业。他的著作《无路之路》记录了他自己的旅程，并深入探讨了工作的历史，已有超过40,000人阅读。他的播客《无路之路》聚焦于那些走非传统道路的人的对话。他还经营在线培训业务StrategyU，帮助人们学习咨询技能，而无需在该行业工作。在我们的对话中，保罗分享了：• “默认路径”和“无路之路”的解释

title.en: Redefining success, money, and belonging | Paul Millerd (The Pathless Path)
title.zh: 重新定义成功、金钱和归属感 | 保罗·米勒德（《无路之路》）

summary.en: Paul reframes the 'default path' of work and life as a script we unconsciously follow, and argues that consciously choosing uncertainty can open a more fulfilling route. He shares how a three-month sabbatical - or even a three-hour weekday reset - can create the space to discover what you actually want, and why founders should embrace offering sabbaticals. The conversation is a practical invitation to question the script and design a life on your own terms.
summary.zh: Paul 将工作与生活的“默认路径”重新定义为一种我们在无意识中遵循的剧本，并主张有意识地选择不确定性，反而能通向更充实的人生。他分享了三个月的休假——甚至只是工作日里三小时的抽离——如何创造出发现真正所求的空间，以及为什么创始人应当乐于提供休假。本期是一份务实的邀请：质疑那套剧本，按自己的方式设计人生。
